events.title: Demo Hotfix — Settings & UI Fixes
events.summary: Hello Officers!We've just released a small hotfix for the Federal Cadet Demo, addressing several issues reported by players.Fixes & ImprovementsFixed an issue where leaving the settings menu could unexpectedly reload the game.Fixed FOV and brightness settings not being applied correctly.Improved slider controls when using an Xbox controller.Fixed minor UI and text issues.Minor NPC navigation improvements.Thank you for your feedback and support!More improvements are on the way!— LeeRanger Studio

events.title: Demo Update – Xbox Controller Support, Driving & AI Improvements
events.summary: A new update for the Federal Cadet demo is now available!This update brings major improvements to controller support, vehicle handling, NPC behavior, and traffic AI, alongside new police sirens, improved 4K interface support, and additional optimizations.🎮 Full Xbox Controller SupportThe demo now supports Xbox controllers throughout the entire gameplay experience, including:Character movement and camera controls.Interactions with the environment.Navigation through menus.Police tablet navigation.

events.title: Federal Cadet Demo Update – Driving, AI & Community Feedback Improvements
